source.name: SFBay (Bay City News) – 'Warriors announce "Chase Arena" as future home'
source.quote: The financial services firm JPMorgan Chase paid for naming rights for 20 years at the 18,000-seat arena

note: Arena naming rights: Chase Center (the arena opened in 2019; the naming-rights deal was announced in January 2016, for 20 years). Start date and value unknown from this source.
